financial_finding: Q1 FY27 revenue $479.0M (+114.7% YoY), GAAP operating margin 25.2%, OCF $90.2M, capex $7.3M and SBC $88.0M. OCF-capex-SBC is approximately -$5.0M, but working-capital cash outflow was $151.3M and should not be annualized.
economic_risk: AECs contributed over 90% of the YoY revenue increase and four end customers represented 33%/28%/13%/10% of revenue. Product-market evidence is strong, but concentration and design-loss risk remain material.
rights_and_capital: DustPhotonics purchase consideration was approximately $1.251B, including $895.8M goodwill; net acquisition cash outflow was $735.6M. Q1 diluted weighted-average shares were 194.378M and SBC/revenue was 18.4%.
falsifier: Loss of a major hyperscaler design or a sustained transition away from Credo AEC/optical solutions combined with weakening per-share owner cash invalidates the widening-moat thesis.
portfolio_instruction: Research completion is not a buy authorization. Positioning requires portfolio risk-budget context.
